articles.title: NVIDIA Board Reinstates Jensen Huang as President, CEO and Board Director
articles.summary: NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) today announced that effective immediately, Jensen Huang has been reinstated as President and Chief Executive Officer and as a member of the Board.

articles.title: NVIDIA Board of Directors Establishes National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee
articles.summary: NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) today announced that the Board of Directors has established the National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee, a new standing committee responsible for board-level oversight of the company’s national security policies, export control compliance and global trade risk management.

articles.title: NVIDIA Announces Collaboration With IBM and Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory to Launch Quantum-Classical Codesign Platform, Plus Error-Correction Breakthrough to Advance Practical Quantum Computing
articles.summary: NVIDIA today announced plans for new collaborations with IBM and the U.S. Department of Energy’s Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory that will span research into next-generation modular architectures for quantum computers, scientific applications and supercomputing integration.

articles.title: NVIDIA Expands Vera CPU Platform to Accelerate Scientific Discovery
articles.summary: NVIDIA today announced the NVIDIA Vera CPU rack-scale platform for high-performance computing — combining NVIDIA’s first fully custom data center CPU with the gold standard for HPC networking to drive extreme efficiency and throughput for state-of-the-art scientific modeling, simulation and agentic science.
